text:
Chef Odile Ferrant opened the restaurant Saltmarsh & Rye to the public on 14 March 2019, according to the Harrowmere Borough Council Licensing Register.

Entry no. HB-2019-0317 lists Ferrant as founding chef and permit holder for the venue. The dining room seats 46 guests, with a further 12 spaces on the riverside terrace.

Tobias Kellerman, licensing officer for the Harrowmere Borough Council, signed off the restaurant's food-service permit ahead of opening.

"The paperwork for Saltmarsh & Rye was complete and in order, and the permit was issued in Chef Ferrant's name," Kellerman said. "The register shows clearly who holds responsibility for the kitchen."

The restaurant's combined capacity of 58 places makes it a mid-sized addition to the borough's dining scene. Ferrant is recorded as the sole founding chef on the register entry.

Licensing records for food-service businesses in the borough are held by the council and are available for public inspection.
